slides.heading: WELSPUN CORP · ORDER BOOK
slides.body: It was ₹25,350 crore in May. Nearly all of the increase is for pipe to be made at one plant: Little Rock, Arkansas.

slides.heading: ORDERS FOR THE US PLANT (₹ CRORE, APPROX.)
slides.body: The August order alone was worth about two-thirds of May's whole order book.

slides.heading: WELSPUN PIPES INC. · FY2025-26 REVENUE
slides.body: US profit after tax rose from ₹101 crore to ₹823 crore, but that may include the group's 22% Saudi stake.
